{{Top|leg}}
More commonly known by the nickname "'''Wreck-out'''", '''Wryk Jobones''' was a veteran [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|racer]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. After spending much of his career racing in illegal and highly dangerous competitions, he retired at the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] and spent much of his time promoting the sport. He petitioned for the improvement of safety and quality of swoop tracks, hoping to extend the career of racers and attract a broader audience.
